title: Outlet Coverage and Card Reduction Across the Mountain Dining Plans
content:
A card on one of the Mountain Dining Plans is taken at the kinds of outlet that plan covers, at the mountains that plan is valid at, and the reduction shown here is the percentage taken off the bill at a collective outlet when the card is presented. This paper holds the coverage each plan carries.

## Kinds of outlet each plan covers

| Plan | Quick service | Cafeteria | Table service | Bar | Chef's table | Private dining | Reduction off the bill |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | covered | — | — | — | — | — | 0 per cent |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | covered | covered | — | — | — | — | 5 per cent |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | covered | covered | covered | — | — | — | 10 per cent |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | covered | covered | covered | covered | — | — | 15 per cent |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | — | 18 per cent |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | covered | 20 per cent |

## Mountains whose outlets take the plan

| Plan | Mountains |
| --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | Granite Ridge |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Copper Hollow |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Copper Hollow |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow |

## Dates on which table service does not take the plan, and what may be paid for

The dates listed are those on which the plan may not be spent at table service outlets. Alcohol and resort retail are shown as the plan admits them, and the last column shows whether the service charge is covered by the card reduction.

| Plan | Dates table service does not take the plan | Alcohol | Resort retail | Service charge covered |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | 2026-12-24, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-31 | not admitted | not admitted | not covered |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | 2026-12-24, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-31 | not admitted | not admitted | not covered |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | 2026-12-24, 2026-12-31 | admitted | not admitted | not covered |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | 2026-12-24 | admitted | admitted | covered |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | none | admitted | admitted | covered |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | none | admitted | admitted | covered |

The two memberships at the head of the range carry no such dates at all, so table service takes them on every date of the season. Christmas Eve is the one date that stands against every plan that carries any.
